data.one_liner: Official iDenfy Flutter plugin for identity verification, KYC, and AML compliance.
data.what_it_does: Provides native mobile SDK integration for identity verification, document scanning, liveness detection, and face authentication using the iDenfy platform.
use_when: You need remote user onboarding and KYC/AML compliance in your app.
You want to integrate iDenfy identity verification or face authentication flows.
avoid_when: You only need basic camera preview or simple QR/barcode scanning without compliance backend integration.
strengths: Official plugin supporting both Android and iOS.
Comprehensive feature set including identity verification, liveness checks, and face authentication.
weaknesses: Requires complex native configurations on Android (multidex, proguard rules) and iOS (Podfile modifications, bitcode disabled).
Depends on a paid external identity verification service.
data.setup_notes: Requires native configuration: enabling multidex and adjusting R8 settings on Android; setting NSCameraUsageDescription, configuring Podfile for iOS 15.0 minimum deployment target, and handling bitcode.
